verdict.rationale: Antigravity's own agents work over the user's project data: they get full codebase context, give context-aware suggestions such as tab autocompletion, and produce Artifacts (plans, diagrams, diffs) that convey their thinking. MCP also lets them connect to databases and fetch structured context. However, nothing documents a dedicated insights or analytics experience that surfaces AI-generated findings from user data, beyond code-task suggestions. Missing for 10: an explicit data-insights or analysis feature, documentation of insight generation over non-code data, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Google Antigravity's Editor view offers tab autocompletion, natural language code commands, and a configurable, and context-aware configurable agent.
providing your agents with all of the context required for your codebase
An Artifact is a structured deliverable created by the agent to accomplish its task and communicate its progress and thinking to the human user.
MCP lets Antigravity fetch structured context directly or execute safe actions on your behalf when needed.
